title: Online conference on the results of Work Package 1 (WP1)

blocks.text: On 15 March 2024, an online conference was held on the results of the analysis of Work Package 1 (WP1) of the Erasmus+ project Green and Digital Universities for Sustainable Development of Kyrgyzstan (GREEN KG).

From April to June 2024, online training sessions on Digital and Green Transformation of Universities were held as part of GREEN KG. The training was organised by Vilnius University and the University of Hamburg.
